author: self
description: Runs Google Gemini CLI inside a ttyd web terminal so you can use it from the ZimaOS dashboard.
tagline: Gemini CLI in a browser terminal

tips.before_install:
1. Create an API key at https://aistudio.google.com/app/apikeys
2. Replace DEIN_GEMINI_API_KEY_HIER in GEMINI_API_KEY before starting.
3. Open http://<ZimaOS-IP>:7682 and type `gemini`.
4. Do not expose port 7682 to the public internet without extra protection.

title: Gemini CLI
